title: Miller, Thakor receive faculty achievement awards
summary_en: Timothy Miller and Anjan Thakor are the recipients of WashU’s 2026 faculty achievement awards. They were among several people recognized during WashU’s annual Founders Day celebration.
title_cn: Miller, Thakor receive faculty achievement awards

title: 40-year mystery solved: Common gut virus infects bacteria, not human cells
summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers have rewritten the story on a group of viruses once thought to directly infect human tissue and play a role in gastrointestinal disease. They found that the common virus actually infects gut bacteria, redefining how these viruses impact human health.
title_cn: 40-year mystery solved: Common gut virus infects bacteria, not human cells
